definitions.explanation: A white surface or background, especially on fabric, paper, or ceramics, onto which patterns or text may be applied.
An empty, unfilled area on a document, form, or surface where nothing has been written or printed.

examples.japanese: {白地|しろじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧⟦{花柄|はながら}→花柄：26238_hanagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワンピース→ワンピース：04526_wanpiisu⟧。
examples.english: A dress with a blue floral pattern on a white background.

examples.japanese: {白地|しろじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{水玉|みずたま}→水玉：16173_mizutama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: She is wearing a white shirt with red polka dots.

examples.japanese: {白地|しろじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{藍色|あいいろ}→藍色：15519_aiiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The indigo pattern on the white tea bowl is beautiful.

examples.japanese: {白地|しろじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦サインして→サインする：09864_sainsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please sign in the blank area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白地|しろじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未調査|みちょうさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: The blank areas on the map indicate unsurveyed regions.

examples.japanese: {白地|しろじ}⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{国名|こくめい}→国名：26127_kokumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{込|こ}む→書き込む：04599_kakikomu⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We had a class where we filled in country names on a blank map.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧ (white) and {地|じ} (ground, base, fabric). The {地|じ} here refers to the base surface or background, the same character used in ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧ (fabric, material).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白地|しろじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧～ — a pattern/design on a white background
- {白地|しろじ}⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧ — blank map (outline map without labels)
- {白地|しろじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧ — plain white plate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無地|むじ}→無地：03990_muji⟧ — solid color, plain (no pattern at all, not necessarily white)
- ⟦{余白|よはく}→余白：06838_yohaku⟧ — margin, blank space (on paper or in a document)
- {黒地|くろじ} — black background (same pattern with different color)
